rules.rule: Capacity preflight required before any spawn decision
Each worker must have a contract before spawn_requested
Worker assignments cannot overlap in scope
Replacement policy: failed agent spawns replacement with new contract
Main Agent cannot write worker scope under any circumstance
Integrator is sole merge owner; Main Agent cannot bypass
Verifier blocks closure; Main Agent cannot override
Stale worker (>5min no heartbeat) triggers audit
All scheduling decisions logged to AGENT_EVENTS.jsonl
